tanksjekk.svarNaa: The tank is {alder} years old. Many insurers reduce the payout for leaks from tanks this old. Replace it now, before it leaks.

tanksjekk.utenJs: Under 15 years: keep an eye on the tank. 15 to 19 years: plan a replacement. 20 years or more: replace it now. Many insurers treat a tank as old after about 20 years.

fastpriser.ingress: We do these jobs often, so we know what they take. If the new one goes where the old one was, the work has a fixed price. Send a photo of what is being replaced, and we confirm the price.
fastpriser.note: Fixed price on the work. Call-out fee, equipment and parts come on top.

rader.merknad: New water heater in the same place, with safety valve and mixing valve
A valve on the main line with sensors where leaks are most common
New outdoor tap on an outside wall, connected to the pipe inside
Fitting the cabinet, basin and tap where the old one was
Replacing the mixer tap in the kitchen
Floor-standing toilet in the same place
Replacing the stopcock where the water comes in

prosess.tekst: Send photos of the bathroom as it is today, rough measurements and what you would like. If you live in a housing co-operative, check with the board early.
We look at the bathroom, the pipes and the drain, and what it takes to make the room watertight and up to current standards.
You get a written offer for the plumbing, as a fixed price or an estimate, stating who does what if an electrician and a tiler are involved.
We agree on a start date and the order of work together, and we coordinate with the other tradespeople, so you don't have to be the project manager.
The pipes go in, the membrane and drain are checked, and everything that will be hidden is photographed before the walls are closed.
The fittings are installed and tested. You get FDV documentation and documentation of the plumbing work in the wet room.

bad.ansvar: When an electrician and a tiler work through Kobber og Kran, your agreement is with Kobber og Kran. You have one number to call and one firm to deal with if something is not as agreed. If you bring your own tradespeople, you agree in writing who is responsible for what before work starts.

punkter: Turn off the main stopcock. It is usually where the water comes into the house: in the cellar, the utility room, under the kitchen sink or by the water heater. If you have a well, you can also switch off the pump.
Switch off the power to the water heater at the fuse box if the tank is leaking or the water is turned off.
Mop up what you can, and take photos of the damage and of what is leaking.
Report it to your insurer. Most have their own emergency service that can come and dry things out.
lekkerNaa.ingenDognvakt: We take urgent jobs when we can, but Kobber og Kran does not have a 24-hour emergency service. If we can't answer, your insurer's emergency service is the quickest help.
